title: FactCheck
description: The Verifier Agent's verdict on one claim, with the evidence it relied on. Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::FactCheck. PRD section 6.3. Consumed by the L6 fact-level highlighting view.

claim_id.description: The scene_id the claim came from.

claim_text.description: The exact claim that was checked.

confidence.description: 0.0 to 1.0. A deterministic strict-gate failure reports 0.95 without ever calling the LLM.

evidence_span.description: The source text that supports or contradicts the claim. This is what the dashboard highlights in the source pane when a reviewer clicks the claim.

evidence_fact_id.description: Fact.id the evidence came from. Null when nothing was retrieved, which is the usual shape of an UNVERIFIABLE verdict.

reason.description: Why it failed. Fed back to the Script Writer verbatim on repair, and shown to the reviewer — so it must name the specific error, e.g. "claim states 500000 but source says 50000".

attempt.description: Which repair attempt produced this check. 1-indexed, capped at 3, after which the verdict escalates to NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

Verdict.title: Verdict
Verdict.description: Mirrors backend/app/schemas.py::Verdict. CONTRADICTED means the source actively disagrees; UNVERIFIABLE means the source is silent. Never collapse the two — a reviewer acts differently on each.
